brand.name: Blush & Bloom
brand.design_personality: Romantic Editorial Haute Boutique — blending Jaipur artisanal grace, modern Parisian editorial typography, and high-fashion tactile luxury

aesthetic_archetype.name: Romantic Editorial Luxury (Pastel Rose x Rose Gold x Deep Espresso Ink)
aesthetic_archetype.rationale: Transcends generic bubblegum pink by pairing subtle blush porcelain, warm rose-gold metallic luster (#B76E79 / #D4A373), and deep espresso rose ink (#2A171A). Breaks standard e-commerce grid with arched photo silhouettes, asymmetric editorial bento, and smooth momentum interaction.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight font-normal

layout_and_grids.hero_section: Asymmetric editorial split: Left column features bold Cormorant Garamond title with delicate italic serifs, floating curation tag, and CTA group. Right column houses an arched portrait frame (`rounded-t-[120px] rounded-b-[24px]`) with subtle floating Rose Gold Badge 'Handcrafted in Jaipur & Bombay'.
layout_and_grids.categories_bento: Tetris Grid mode with uneven spans: Dresses & Clothing (col-span-12 md:col-span-7 h-[420px]), Luxury Bags & Clutches (col-span-12 md:col-span-5 h-[420px]), Artisanal Jewellery (col-span-12 md:col-span-4 h-[360px]), Hair & Fashion Accessories (col-span-12 md:col-span-8 h-[360px]).
layout_and_grids.product_grid: Responsive 1 -> 2 -> 4 column card layout (`grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6`). Direct children wrapped in framer-motion stagger containers.
layout_and_grids.special_offer_strip: Full-bleed editorial banner with warm tinted dusk background (#241417), metallic foil accent typography, live countdown timer ('FESTIVE EDIT — 20% OFF CODE: BLOOM20'), and quick copy CTA.
layout_and_grids.footer: High-contrast espresso-noir (#1F1215) with rose gold watermark typography ('BLUSH & BLOOM' at 11vw), category links, WhatsApp concierge badge, and Indian payment trust badges (UPI, RuPay, Visa, Mastercard, NetBanking, COD).

component_architecture.Navbar: Sticky luxury glass header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFF7F8]/85 border-b border-[#B76E79]/15 z-50). Contains: Brand Wordmark in Cormorant Garamond, Navigation links (Shop, New In, Categories, Our Story, Contact), Search bar dialog trigger, Wishlist, Cart Drawer counter badge, and Mobile slide-over menu.
component_architecture.HeroEditorial: Kinetic editorial hero with masked text reveal, floating artisanal stats ('100% Handcrafted', 'Pan-India Delivery in 3-5 Days', 'INR ₹ Transparent Pricing'), and dual CTAs: 'Explore Collection' + 'Shop on WhatsApp'.
component_architecture.EditorialMarquee: Soft sage/rose organic drifting ribbon with phrases: 'HANDCRAFTED LUXURY' • 'CONTEMPORARY INDIAN SILHOUETTES' • 'FREE SHIPPING ABOVE ₹1,999' • 'CASH ON DELIVERY & UPI' • 'ETHICALLY SOURCED FABRICS'.
component_architecture.CategoryBento: Interactive bento showcase with arched imagery, zoom micro-interactions, category item counts, and quick filter links.
component_architecture.ProductCard: Editorial card with: arched or rounded-xl image frame, heart wishlist toggle, quick size selector chips (XS, S, M, L, XL, Free Size), hover second image flip / spotlight zoom, INR formatted price with strike-through original price, tag ('Bestseller', 'Handmade', 'New'), and direct 'Add to Bag' button.
component_architecture.ProductDetailModalOrPage: Deep-dive view with image gallery, size guide in inches/cm, fabric details (Mulmul Cotton, Chanderi Silk, Brass Rose Gold Plating), COD availability check with Indian pincode input, WhatsApp order trigger with pre-filled message, and Add to Cart.
component_architecture.CartDrawer: Slide-out right sheet with free shipping progress bar (Free shipping unlock threshold: ₹1,999), order notes, item increment/decrement, coupon code input ('BLOOM20' for 20% off), and checkout trigger.
component_architecture.CheckoutModal: Streamlined Indian checkout supporting: 1. Cash on Delivery (COD), 2. UPI / NetBanking / Cards mock gateway (Razorpay/PhonePe styled simulation with instant confirmation), 3. 'Order via WhatsApp' (generates live WhatsApp text with order items and shipping address).
component_architecture.AdminPanel: Secret/Accessible product manager with password access ('admin123'). Allows: Add new product with category, price in INR, image URL, sizes, tag; Edit existing product; Delete product; LocalStorage persistent storage so custom changes persist.
component_architecture.WhatsAppConcierge: Floating bottom-right button with pulse aura and quick chat popup ('Hello! Need help choosing your size or looking for custom styling? Chat with our stylist on WhatsApp').

micro_interactions.cursor_effects: Subtle rose gold magnetic dot on desktop and smooth hover state zooms.
micro_interactions.buttons: Pill-shaped with rose-gold metallic gradient or crisp espresso border; slight -translate-y-0.5 and shadow-md on hover.
micro_interactions.toasts: Sonner toasts with pastel pink background, rose-gold accents, and clear action confirmations ('Added to your bag', 'Coupon BLOOM20 applied!').

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, search input, filter tab, card, and checkout step MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.

anti_ai_rules: DO NOT use generic centered bootstrap columns. Use asymmetric offsets and editorial arches.
DO NOT use pure black (#000000) or cold blue slate. Neutral base must be warm blush porcelain (#FFF7F8) and text must be deep espresso rose ink (#241417).
DO NOT use AI assistant emoji icons (🤖🧠💡). Use Lucide icons with customized stroke widths (1.5px).
DO NOT make headers with standard Inter font. Must use Cormorant Garamond / Bodoni Moda for headlines.
ALL prices must clearly be in Indian Rupees (INR ₹) formatted cleanly as ₹1,499, ₹2,899 etc.
Header must never be completely transparent. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFF7F8]/85 with subtle rose gold 1px border.
mobile_rules: Ensure seamless touch experience on 390px (iPhone / Android) screens.
Sticky bottom mobile bar or accessible floating WhatsApp CTA that never obscures checkout or cart buttons.
Horizontal scrollable pill tabs for categories on mobile screens for effortless one-thumb switching.
state_management: Cart state (items, quantity, selected sizes) stored in React Context or localStorage.
Admin CRUD operations mutate product state in localStorage so newly added dresses or accessories show up immediately in Shop and Homepage.
